first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with two inherited findings indicating improved completion, time-to-value, adoption, and durable first-week activation. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, but its pooled cohorts and mid-test redefinition warrant verification before relying on its revenue claim. The onboarding evidence still centers on early-product outcomes rather than proven long-term qualified revenue, so downstream retention and revenue quality should be guarded in the experiment.
